fields.title: Which number to trust
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Product: 20 148 orders yesterday. Dashboard: 20 106. Name three likely reasons and state which number goes into the quarterly report for partners.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: Reasons — export delay; different definitions (analytics excludes cancelled and test orders); day boundary based on different fields. The report uses the number from the data warehouse: it is reproducible, the same query in a month will return the same number. The product database changes under your hands, and a repeat report from it will be different. Demanding a match is pointless — you must know the difference.
